playstyle: Six fragile Chaos raiders with modest health and single dodge saves, trading durability for numbers and flexible threats. Most fighters gain Move, Attack dice and better saves when Inspired, while Grundann's Brutal hammer and Shond's Cleave blades crack tough targets and Jagathra and Ollo add range-3 chip damage. With no warscroll of its own, it borrows a generic Chaos one, Inspiring either by outnumbering foes in neutral territory or by chaining melee kills. It wins by swarming objectives and picking off weakened enemies.
